column1: # Scope: the runtime base images in scripts/ci/scan-images.txt — see that
# file's header for why those and not (yet) the published registry images.
# THE HEADLINE IS THE SHAPE OF THAT TABLE, NOT THE TOTAL.
# The two images carrying every one of the 28 are the Node ones, and the
# distroless/debian bases the Rust services run on are CLEAN. This is direct
# evidence for a decision this repository already made — the Rust services ship
# on distroless — and a direct argument about the one that lags:
#   secureprompt-chat is on node:20-alpine and carries 20; secureprompt-web is
#   on node:22-alpine and carries 8. Twelve of chat's twenty, INCLUDING the
#   only OpenSSL one (CVE-2026-45447 in libcrypto3/libssl3), are absent from
#   node:22-alpine. Moving secureprompt-chat/Dockerfile from node:20-alpine to
#   node:22-alpine would clear them in one line.
#     FOLLOW-UP WS6-2-FU5. It is not done in this commit because bumping the
#     Node major of the vendored LibreChat fork is a compatibility question for
#     that fork, not a CI question, and it needs its own test run.
# Most of the rest are CVEs in npm's OWN bundled tooling (tar, minimatch, glob,
# brace-expansion, sigstore) that ships inside the node image rather than in
# our application's dependencies. They are still in the shipped image, so they
# are still listed; they are not reachable from the gateway's request path.
# Key: <image> <TAB> <package> <TAB> <CVE>. The installed/fixed VERSIONS are in
# the trailing informational column and are NOT compared — upstream rebuilds
# floating tags like `node:22-alpine` constantly, so a version-keyed baseline
# would churn on every rebuild that changed a package but not its CVE set.
# Fails in BOTH directions, like scripts/ci/fmt-gate.sh:
#   * a finding NOT here  -> FAIL. A new fixable HIGH/CRITICAL appeared.
#   * a row here that is no longer reported -> FAIL. Upstream fixed it; delete
#     the row so the baseline shrinks.
# EXPECT THE SECOND KIND ROUTINELY, and that is the design working rather than
# a nuisance: these are floating tags, so upstream rebuilds WILL retire rows.
# That is also exactly why this job is scheduled and does not gate merges —
# Columns: image <TAB> package <TAB> cve <TAB> severity <TAB> versions
